events.body:
If you use Supabase Auth, Resend is available to send its emails through custom SMTP.

Resend is an email sending platform for developers. Our Supabase guide shows where to enter SMTP credentials for signup, login, and password-reset emails.

Resend Pro costs **$20 per month** for 50,000 emails monthly, with **no Resend daily email limit**. Those terms are worth assessing before a launch or an increase in signups.

Switching SMTP providers does not remove Supabase’s separate Auth rate limit. Supabase initially sets custom SMTP Auth sending at 30 messages per hour; you can adjust that limit in its Auth Rate Limits dashboard.

The pricing page compares Pro’s terms with Free’s 100-email daily cap, so you can decide whether Pro fits your expected auth email volume before configuring SMTP.

Those logs still leave you to find a provider’s SMTP credentials and adjust Supabase’s separate Auth rate limit.

Introducing Resend, an email sending platform for developers. If you use Supabase Auth, our guide shows where to enable custom SMTP and get Resend’s credentials. The SMTP host is smtp.resend.com, with resend as the username.

Resend Pro has no Resend daily sending limit. Supabase initially sets a 30-message-per-hour Auth limit for custom SMTP, which you can adjust on its Rate Limits page. Connecting a provider alone does not change that setting.

events.body:
Resend is available to send Supabase Auth email through custom SMTP.

If you use Supabase for sign-up, password reset, invites, or OTP, Resend gives you an email sending platform for those messages. Our Supabase-specific guide shows where to enable custom SMTP and where to obtain your Resend credentials.

Custom SMTP gives you a separate sending provider. Supabase initially applies its own Auth limit of **30 messages per hour**, which you can adjust in Supabase’s Rate Limits settings. Resend’s Free plan has a separate **100-emails-per-day** limit; Pro has no daily sending limit.

The guide lets you inspect the setup before creating an account or changing production Auth settings, then decide whether it fits your project.

If you use Supabase Auth for signup or OTP email, its built-in sender is not the only route.

Resend is an email sending platform available to send Supabase Auth messages through custom SMTP. Our Supabase guide shows where to enable SMTP and where to get Resend credentials. You can inspect the steps before creating an account or changing Auth settings.
